provides_route.canary_enforcement: WIRED by AUP-GRAPH-008: `canary` is mandatory for this edge type. Without a CanaryResult/v1 listing the entity, verify.py records it not_measured and the admission is paused_safe — which is exactly what the matrix demanded in prose before the verifier existed. The gate tools/graph/deploy_gate.py can-i-deploy applies the same rule per contract edge, and adds the offline half (route presence between the resident version and the candidate). A flag never substitutes for the canary: --force needs a registry exemption (rule D4).

FR-01.name: no-transport-to-persistence
FR-01.rule: a transport-layer unit (*.controller.ts, *.gateway.ts, *.resolver.ts) must not import a persistence unit (prisma.service*, @prisma/client, *.repository.ts, typeorm)
FR-01.source: imports edges of the head graph + the head import statements

FR-02.name: no-import-cycles
FR-02.rule: no strongly connected component of size > 1 over value imports (import type / export type excluded) among code units of one deployable

FR-03.name: module-boundary
FR-03.rule: a unit under src/<a>/ may import from src/<b>/ (a ≠ b) only through the module's exported surface: never another module's *.controller.ts / *.gateway.ts / *.processor.ts
FR-03.source: imports edges of the head graph

FR-04.name: reuse-marker-resolves
FR-04.rule: a `reuse: @arcanada/<pkg>` marker must name a package declared as a dependency of the containing deployable or present as a workspace package (packages/*), or be registered in the exemption registry
FR-04.source: reuse-marker imports edges of the head graph + package.json files at head

FR-05.name: deployable-boundary
FR-05.rule: a unit of deployable A must not import a unit of deployable B unless B is a shared package (kind library / shared_package)
FR-05.source: imports + deploys_to edges of the head graph

receipt.not_measured_reason: historical receipt: asserted, never re-verified (I14); a new receipt supersedes it

work_item.not_measured_reason: no local verifier for a work item; GRAPH-006 links the admission receipt to the work item in Muneral

principles: P1 every affected entity (deterministic core, inferred tail, changed nodes) receives exactly one tri-valued verdict verified | failed | not_measured; the runner may not drop an entity without a verdict (card failure condition)
P2 mandatory verifiers are executed locally by the change author's agent; a mandatory verifier that cannot run (tool absent, no toolchain) yields not_measured with the reason, never verified
P3 tests are never mandatory 'just in case': targeted_test and property_check are selectable and bound to an edge type (verifies) or a declared property, not to the whole change

P4 a disabled mandatory verifier is recorded as MANDATORY_VERIFIER_DISABLED; the entities it would have covered become not_measured and the draft can never be admitted — the mutation battery shows every mandatory verifier is load-bearing (fault caught when enabled, mutant survives when disabled)

P5 fitness rules run over the head tree with a frozen baseline of pre-existing violations (FitnessBaseline/v1, owner + expiry) and an exemption registry; a new violation is failed, a frozen one is reported and not counted, an expired baseline counts again
P6 an inferred edge across a service/repo boundary never yields verified alone: the entity stays not_measured until a canary (GRAPH-008) lists it (CAR rule INFERRED_BOUNDARY_WITHOUT_CANARY)
purpose: For every edge type and node type of RelationshipGraph/v1: which verifiers are MANDATORY (run locally by `arcana verify`, never CI-only) and which are SELECTABLE. The graph selects verification, it never replaces it (consilium 2026-09-05): an affected entity with no applicable verifier gets `not_measured`, and not_measured blocks unqualified admission (ChangeAdmissionReceipt/v1 admission rule).
selection_rule: required(entity) = ⋃ edge_types[t].mandatory over the edge types t of the hops that reach the entity in its best path (impact.py ImpactQuery/v1 path) ∪ node_types[type(entity)].mandatory; for a changed node (seed) required = node_types[type].mandatory. Selected selectable verifiers (--select) are added when applicable. verdict(entity) = failed if any verifier reports failed for it; not_measured if any required verifier is missing / disabled / not attributable; verified only when every required verifier reports verified for it (and, for inferred boundary entities, a canary lists it).
status: normative-draft — ratification by blind agent review (DEC-AUP-0010 reviewer_incarnation), not by a human gate

canary.verdict_rule: implemented by AUP-GRAPH-008: tools/graph/verify.py --canary <CanaryResult/v1> consumes live-contour evidence produced by tools/graph/deploy_gate.py canary. An entity that needs a canary and is not listed by any supplied result is not_measured (INFERRED_BOUNDARY_WITHOUT_CANARY); a listed entity carries the canary's own tri-valued verdict, and only a `verified` one lifts the inferred-boundary hold P6.
canary.what: observed edge / deployment canary for inferred boundary edges and can-i-deploy

config_schema.verdict_rule: verified when every key read is declared; failed on UNDECLARED_CONFIG_KEY unless frozen in the baseline; not_measured when the repo declares no env source at all
config_schema.what: every config key read by an affected code unit at head (process.env.X, process.env['X'], configService.get('X')) is declared in an env declaration source of the repo (.env.example / .env.schema / .env.template / env.schema.json / docker-compose*.yml environment:), framework-owned prefixes excluded (NODE_ENV, CI, PORT, NEXT_*, VERCEL_*, NEXTAUTH_*, AUTH_*, WS_NO_*, NO_PROXY, DEBUG)

contract_diff.verdict_rule: provider: verified when no breaking change on the contract, failed when a breaking change lands on it (compatible/info codes keep verified); consumer edge verdict from the usage projection (failed / verified / not_measured when the projection is not narrowable)
contract_diff.what: schema-lite of every contract taken from code at base and head; breaking-change taxonomy; consumer ⊆ provider over implements_contract / consumes_contract edges

doc_reference.verdict_rule: verified when every reference into the change set resolves; failed on DANGLING_REFERENCE
doc_reference.what: every path / route / model reference a document makes to the change set still resolves at head (file exists, route served, model present)

fitness_rules.verdict_rule: verified when the code unit has no new violation (frozen violations reported in the summary); failed on a new violation or an expired baseline entry
fitness_rules.what: architecture fitness rules over the head graph + head sources: layers, cycles, module boundaries, reuse markers, deployable boundaries — executed locally, not only in CI

property_check.tool: declared per node in the repo profile (.arcana/verify.json → property_checks) or --profile
property_check.verdict_rule: verified on exit 0, failed otherwise; not run when no property is declared for the node

route_config_consistency.verdict_rule: verified when RC-01..03 hold for the route; failed on UNREGISTERED_CONTROLLER / PREFIX_MISMATCH / ROUTE_REMOVED_WITH_CONSUMER
route_config_consistency.what: RC-01 the global prefix set in the bootstrap (setGlobalPrefix) equals the prefix the route node was built with; RC-02 the controller / gateway that provides the route is registered (controllers: / providers:) in a @Module reachable from the root module passed to NestFactory.create; RC-03 the served route still exists in the head graph

schema_diff.tool: tools/graph/verify.py prisma-lite diff + `prisma validate` when the CLI is available
schema_diff.verdict_rule: verified when the model has no breaking change and prisma validate passes (or the CLI is absent and the schema-lite parse is clean: then not_measured for the validate half is recorded in the summary and the entity stays not_measured); failed when a breaking change lands on the model and a consumer (maps_model from a code unit) references the removed/changed field, or prisma validate fails; not_measured when breaking but consumer usage is not narrowable
schema_diff.what: Prisma schema-lite (models, fields, types, optionality, lists, enums) at base and head; breaking taxonomy MODEL_REMOVED / FIELD_REMOVED / FIELD_TYPE_CHANGED / FIELD_MADE_REQUIRED / NEW_REQUIRED_FIELD_WITHOUT_DEFAULT / ENUM_VALUE_REMOVED / RELATION_CHANGED; prisma validate of the head schema

targeted_test.tool: the deployable's test runner (jest / vitest) restricted to the spec files whose `verifies` edge reaches an affected node
targeted_test.verdict_rule: verified for the spec node and the units it verifies when the run exits 0; failed otherwise (a test that needs an absent environment fails honestly — the summary records the cause)
targeted_test.what: existing tests covering the affected node; never the whole suite

type_check.tool: tsc --noEmit --incremental false -p <tsconfig> (per deployable; test tsconfig when a spec is affected)
type_check.verdict_rule: verified when the project containing the entity compiles with 0 errors; failed when an error is reported in the entity's file; not_measured when the project fails only in other files (error not attributable) or tsc is unavailable
type_check.what: compilation of the deployable that contains the affected caller / importer / controller / consumer at the head tree
